assigned.title: Optional API-driven autonomous dispatcher
assigned.acceptance: Optional external agent runner can dispatch queued tasks to configured providers with budgets, audit logs, retries, and human approval gates

unit.evidence: EXECUTED on 8166a63, the reconciled range f6c4b942..HEAD. (1) node scripts/cloud/test-dispatcher.mjs -> 35 scenarios, exit 0. (2) npm run test:scripts, which is the alias CI runs and which now includes the dispatcher suite -> 38 env scenarios + 70 control-plane scenarios + 27 workspace-dep groups + 21 turbo-graph groups + 20 validate-repo groups + 35 dispatcher scenarios, exit 0. (3) node scripts/ai-control-plane.mjs validate -> valid, 68 tasks, 9 agents. DEFAULT-OFF OBSERVED RATHER THAN ASSUMED, because an optional spending mechanism that is only documented as off is not evidenced as off: resolveDispatcherConfig over the shipped control/adapters.json returns enabled=false with enableEnvVar=LIBERTY_DISPATCHER_ENABLED, dispatcherIsArmed(cfg, {}) returns false, and dispatcherIsArmed(cfg, {LIBERTY_DISPATCHER_ENABLED: "1"}) ALSO returns false -- the committed switch and the runtime switch must both be on, so arming the environment cannot by itself make a checkout dispatch. ACCEPTANCE CHECKED CLAUSE BY CLAUSE against the existing implementation, and no gap was found, so nothing was implemented this round: configurable providers -> control/adapters.json declares two (openai-responses and agent-bus) with a runner seam in dispatch-runners.mjs; budgets -> budgetDecision, ledgerSpend, estimateCost, the UNREADABLE_LEDGER symbol, perRunCeiling and perTaskCeiling both 0, and a persistent ledger at coordination/agent-bus/dispatch/ledger.json; audit logs -> coordination/agent-bus/dispatch/audit.jsonl, which is also where retry attempts are counted from so the ceiling survives a restart; retries -> retryDecision with maxAttempts 3 and deterministic unjittered backoff; human approval gates -> requiredApprovalCategories and validateApproval, reading escalation.humanOnly from control/policies.json rather than restating it, with an approvals directory the dispatcher cannot write to by construction. Nine refusal codes exist and five of them fire on the shipped configuration at once: dispatcher_disabled, runner_unavailable, cost_unknown, budget_ceiling_not_set and human_approval_missing. NOT DONE, DELIBERATELY: no live OpenAI runner was added. The openai-responses provider is a declared seam that refuses with runner_unavailable, and cost null refuses independently with cost_unknown. Writing a model-calling runner here would mean shipping a spending path that cannot be exercised or costed from this session, which is the opposite of what the design does on purpose; gpt-architect's round-76 direction says so explicitly.

assigned.notes: SURFACE DERIVED MECHANICALLY FROM HISTORY, round 77, under gpt-architect's round-71 evidence-based narrowing procedure and its round-76 direction that this task is NOT greenfield. All four dispatcher scripts were created by exactly one commit, 719d2d7, and no commit has touched any of them since. control/adapters.json changed exactly once in the review range, in that same commit, and its parent tree contains no dispatcher configuration at all. coordination/agent-bus/dispatch/** was created there, and the eight lines 719d2d7 added to coordination/agent-bus/README.md are entirely about that directory. DROPPED `packages/**` outright: measured, this task wrote nothing under it. `control/**`, `scripts/**` and `docs/**` are replaced by the specific files, because 719d2d7 was a NINE-LANE commit touching 145 files and inheriting those prefixes would have presented eight other lanes' work as this task's. TWO FILES THIS TASK GENUINELY WROTE ARE reviewDependencies RATHER THAN allowedPaths, stated rather than quietly dropped. .github/workflows/ci.yml: this task contributed one step (`Test the optional dispatcher` running scripts/cloud/test-dispatcher.mjs) and its comment, but 326 lines changed in the review range across four commits, and the other three are PL-AI-0002's two CI checks and PL-0704's two browser-gate rounds -- work already reviewed and approved under those ids. docs/GITHUB_SETUP.md: 719d2d7 created the whole document, but only section 3, `The optional dispatcher (PL-AI-0003)`, is this task's; sections 1 and 2 are the GitHub bridge. In both cases claiming the file would make the review range false in the direction the procedure most cares about -- other tasks' approved work appearing as this one's. package.json is a reviewDependency because the ci.yml comment records that the `test:scripts` alias could not be extended in this task's own round, package.json being outside its surface; the follow-up landed under another id.

implementationBaseProvenance.reason: Derived mechanically, not guessed. All four dispatcher scripts (agent-dispatcher.mjs, dispatch-policy.mjs, dispatch-runners.mjs, test-dispatcher.mjs) were CREATED by 719d2d7 and no commit has touched any of them since; control/adapters.json gained its entire dispatcher block in that same commit and changed nowhere else in the range; coordination/agent-bus/dispatch/** was created there. f6c4b942 is 719d2d7's first parent, and its tree was checked directly: none of the four scripts exist in it and its control/adapters.json contains no occurrence of the string dispatch. So the base is the last commit before any part of this implementation existed, and the range opens exactly where the work does.
